rationale: The workflow already implements the Maven dependency cache recommended by the measured evidence (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE): path ~/.m2/repository, key ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}, with restore-keys ${{ runner.os }}-maven-. Those experiments reported 20-51% elapsed savings from adding exactly this cache, so there is no missing cache to add and inserting a duplicate step would be redundant rather than an optimization. Other candidate optimizations do not have met prerequisites: the matrix contains a single java value (fail-fast matrix cancellation would not save meaningful work), there is no completed CI history to derive a custom or history-based timeout (ci_history status is no_completed_runs), and required-check status is unverified so adding cancel-in-progress could affect required-check semantics. Build and test coverage (mvn clean package on JDK 11) is preserved as-is.
